payout_quote: Neuromodulatory Treatment Response Biomarkers for Depression ... Compensation: up to $200
steps: Open the UCSD Interventional Psychiatry clinical trials page
Locate the 'Neuromodulatory Treatment Response Biomarkers for Depression' trial, which lists 75 healthy control volunteers as a target population
Confirm eligibility: healthy control volunteer, 18 or older
Contact the team at iptrials@health.ucsd.edu or 858-657-6149 to express interest
Complete the brain physiology assessment session for healthy volunteers: fMRI, TMS-EMG, TMS-EEG, resting state EEG, and EEG during game-based cognitive assessments
catches: 'Up to $200' — amount may vary with completed requirements; exact healthy-control payment breakdown not stated
Healthy volunteers undergo TMS-based procedures (TMS-EMG, TMS-EEG) — non-invasive magnetic brain stimulation used as a research assessment, not treatment
Session duration is not stated on the page; time below is an honest estimate for a multi-modal imaging/stimulation session
The rest of the program's active trials require diagnosed treatment-resistant depression and involve receiving treatment
biggest_catch: Up to $200 for one multi-modal brain physiology assessment session that includes TMS (magnetic brain stimulation) as a research assessment in healthy volunteers.
eligibility: Healthy control volunteer, 18 or older (trial also recruits right-handed volunteers 18+ prescribed neuromodulatory treatment for MDD — that arm is not this route).
timing: One brain physiology assessment session; payment timing not stated on the page.
